query_text: what is the funnest terraria class

content.text:
The **funnest Terraria class** is usually **Summoner**, especially in modern Terraria.

Why Summoner is so fun:
- You get **minions that fight for you**
- You can focus on **dodging and movement**
- Whips make the class more active than it used to be
- It feels very different from the usual sword/bow/magic playstyles
- By late game, you can have a whole swarm of creatures attacking bosses

That said, “funnest” depends on what you like:

| Class | Fun factor |
|---|---|
| **Summoner** | Best if you like chaos, pets, dodging, and letting minions shred enemies |
| **Mage** | Best if you like flashy weapons, variety, and big damage spells |
| **Ranger** | Best if you like consistency, guns, bows, and easier boss fights |
| **Melee** | Best if you like tankiness, close combat, and huge late-game weapons |

My pick: **Summoner for fun**, **Mage for variety**, **Ranger for easiest**, and **Melee for comfort**.

If you’ve already beaten Terraria before, I’d recommend doing a **pure Summoner run** — it’s one of the most entertaining ways to replay the game.
